detail.longDescription:
Hey, Mastodon!  For other self-hosters out there, I'm looking for a quick and easy file sharing app.  Something easy like Google Drive but hosting files on my own NAS.  I basically just need to make directories, put files in them, and share them with a couple of friends that I make accounts for.  Ideally pleasant to look at and gets good security updates.  Something like Nextcloud seems like overkill for my use case.  What's your pick?

#selfhosted #homelab
